newsitem.title: UK: Lonrho LRHO.L may float UK car distributor -paper.
newsitem.headline: Lonrho LRHO.L may float UK car distributor -paper.

text.p: Lonrho Plc may float its UK motor distributor Dutton-Forshaw Group, the Financial Times reported on Thursday.
The newspaper said the conglomerate's chief executive Nicholas Morrell said that Dutton-Forshaw had a future as an independent public company, although he gave no further details.

The report said a question mark has hung over the distributor, which includes Jack Barclay -- the world's largest Bentley and Rolls-Royce dealership -- since Lonrho said last year it planned to focus on mining activities.
